name: Diamond
howToGet: Mine diamond ore or deepslate diamond ore with an iron pickaxe or better - generates from Y=16 down to bedrock, peaking around Y=-59
Loot chests in shipwrecks, buried treasure, mineshafts, bastions, end cities and strongholds
Craft from a block of diamond (9 per block)
uses: Craft diamond tools, weapons and armor
Craft the enchanting table (2 diamonds), jukebox (1) and firework stars with trail effect
Trade to armorer, toolsmith and weaponsmith villagers for emeralds
Duplicate smithing templates at the crafting table (7 diamonds + template + block)
renewable: Non-renewable as a raw item (no farm produces it), but diamond gear is renewable through villager trading.
editionNote: Identical generation and uses in Java and Bedrock. Fortune III raises the drop to 2.2 diamonds per ore on average.
keywords: diamond how to find minecraft y level fortune

name: Netherite Ingot
howToGet: Craft from 4 netherite scraps + 4 gold ingots (shapeless recipe)
Smelt ancient debris into netherite scraps - ancient debris generates in the Nether between Y=8 and Y=119, most common around Y=15
Loot bastion remnant treasure rooms for scraps, ingots and ancient debris
uses: Upgrade diamond gear to netherite on a smithing table (1 netherite upgrade smithing template + 1 ingot per piece)
Netherite items float in lava, never burn, and have higher durability, damage and knockback resistance than diamond
Craft lodestone (8 chiseled stone bricks + 1 ingot)
renewable: Non-renewable: ancient debris does not regenerate and no farm produces it.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Ancient debris never generates exposed to air, so strip mining or bed/TNT blasting at Y=15 is the standard method.
keywords: netherite ingot ancient debris how to get y level upgrade smithing

name: Iron Ingot
howToGet: Smelt iron ore or raw iron - ore generates in two batches (peak around Y=16 and Y=232 in mountains)
Iron golem drops 3-5 per kill: the basis of iron farms
Craft from 9 iron nuggets or a block of iron
Loot village, mineshaft, dungeon and shipwreck chests
uses: The workhorse crafting material: tools, armor, buckets, anvils, hoppers, pistons, shields, shears, rails and more
Craft a block of iron (9 ingots) for beacons and iron golems
Trade to armorer, toolsmith and weaponsmith villagers (4 ingots per emerald)
renewable: Renewable via iron golem farms, zombie drops (rare) and bartering-adjacent sources.
editionNote: Identical in both editions. Iron golem farm designs differ heavily between Java (villager gossip/panic) and Bedrock (beds + villagers).
keywords: iron ingot how to get farm iron golem minecraft

name: Ender Pearl
howToGet: Kill endermen: 0-1 pearls, up to 4 with Looting III
Trade with expert cleric villagers: 5 emeralds per pearl
Barter gold ingots with piglins (small chance, 2-4 pearls)
Loot stronghold altar chests
uses: Craft eyes of ender (pearl + blaze powder) to find and activate the End portal
Thrown pearls teleport you where they land, dealing 5 fall damage - the classic escape and traversal tool
Pearl teleporting works across dimensions and can clip through 1-block ceilings
renewable: Renewable via enderman farms (the fastest source), cleric trading and piglin bartering.
editionNote: In Java, thrown pearls create a 10-second chunk-loading ticket. In Bedrock there is no such mechanic - pearl cannons and chunk loaders do not work.
keywords: ender pearl how to get enderman farm cleric trade teleport

name: Blaze Rod
howToGet: Kill blazes in Nether fortresses: 0-1 rods, up to 4 with Looting III - blaze spawners in fortresses make this farmable
No other source: blazes are the only mob that drops them
uses: Craft blaze powder (1 rod = 2 powder): fuel for the brewing stand and ingredient for eyes of ender
Brewing stand fuel: 1 powder brews 20 batches
Craft the brewing stand itself (1 rod + 3 cobblestone)
renewable: Renewable via blaze spawner farms in Nether fortresses.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Blazes only spawn in fortress bounding boxes, so farms must be built inside a fortress.
keywords: blaze rod how to get blaze farm brewing fuel

name: Totem of Undying
howToGet: Kill an evoker (woodland mansions and raid waves): always drops exactly 1, unaffected by Looting
Raid farms make totems fully farmable - evokers spawn in raid waves 5+
uses: Hold it in either hand: when you would die, it is consumed instead, restoring you to 1 heart with status effects
Java Edition: Regeneration II for 45s, Fire Resistance I for 40s and Absorption I for 5s. Bedrock Edition: Regeneration II for 30s and Absorption for 5s
Only works while held - totems in your inventory or ender chest do nothing
renewable: Renewable via raid farms; technically unlimited.
editionNote: Effect durations differ: Regeneration II lasts 45s in Java and 30s in Bedrock. The void kills you in both editions - a totem does not save you from /kill or void damage below the world.
keywords: totem of undying evoker raid farm how to get

name: Elytra
howToGet: Found in the item frame of end ships, which generate with some end cities on the outer End islands
Kill the ender dragon first to open the gateways to the outer islands
One elytra per end ship - bring ender pearls or blocks for the bridge
uses: Glide: jump and press jump again mid-air to spread your wings; firework rockets boost you
Repair on an anvil with phantom membranes (or combine two damaged elytra); Mending is strongly recommended
Pair with Unbreaking III: 432 base durability lasts roughly 28 minutes of flight per point of wear
renewable: Not farmable, but effectively unlimited: end cities generate endlessly outward on the outer islands.
editionNote: Identical flight mechanics in both editions. Firework rocket boosting works the same in Java and Bedrock.
keywords: elytra how to find end ship city fly fireworks repair

name: Trident
howToGet: Dropped only by drowned holding a trident - never craftable
Java: 6.25% of drowned spawn with one, 8.5% drop chance (+1% per Looting level)
Bedrock: 15% of drowned spawn with one, 25% drop chance (+4% per Looting level)
Drowned farms (river or converted zombie designs) are the practical source
uses: Melee (9 damage) and throwable weapon - it comes back with Loyalty
Exclusive enchantments: Loyalty (returns), Channeling (summons lightning in thunderstorms), Riptide (launches you in water/rain), Impaling (bonus damage vs aquatic mobs)
Riptide tridents are the fastest pre-elytra travel in rain
renewable: Renewable via drowned farms; repair by combining two tridents or with Mending.
editionNote: Drop rates are much better in Bedrock (25% vs 8.5% base). Impaling also differs: in Bedrock it damages any mob touching water or standing in rain; in Java it only affects aquatic mobs.
keywords: trident how to get drowned drop rate riptide channeling loyalty

name: Nether Star
howToGet: Dropped by the Wither: exactly 1 per kill (Java: unaffected by Looting; the drop cannot burn or despawn for 10 minutes)
Summon the Wither with 4 soul sand/soil in a T plus 3 wither skeleton skulls
Farm wither skeletons in Nether fortresses for skulls (2.5% base, up to 5.5% with Looting III in Java)
uses: Craft the beacon (5 glass + 3 obsidian + 1 nether star) for area status effects and a light beam
Beacons need a pyramid of iron, gold, diamond, emerald or netherite blocks underneath
renewable: Renewable: the Wither can be summoned and killed repeatedly.
editionNote: In Java the nether star cannot be destroyed by explosions and despawns only after 10 minutes; in Bedrock it can be destroyed by explosions - keep it away from the Wither fight.
keywords: nether star wither beacon how to get skull farm

name: Slimeball
howToGet: Kill tiny slimes: 0-2 slimeballs, up to 5 with Looting III - slimes spawn in slime chunks below Y=40 or in swamps at night (peaks at full moon)
Baby pandas have a rare chance to sneeze out a slimeball
Slime farms on slime chunks are the bulk source
uses: Sticky pistons (the heart of most redstone contraptions)
Slime blocks (9 slimeballs) for flying machines, bounce pads and entity launchers
Leads (4 string + 1 slimeball) and magma cream (with blaze powder)
renewable: Renewable via slime farms and panda farms.
editionNote: Slime chunk locations are identical between editions for the same seed. Swamp spawning depends on the moon phase in both editions.
keywords: slimeball how to get slime chunk farm sticky piston
